Your little brother is crying on the sofa. And you have fourteen words left.
In this world, everyone gets a thousand words a day. Spoken or typed. Use them up, and you're silent until midnight. This morning, you had a thousand.
Then the group chat starts a war about pineapple on pizza. Six hundred words later, you win. By lunch, you have forty-one. By dinner, fourteen.
And then Theo knocks on your door.
Can I tell you something? Something real?
